xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4498: Conversation bookmarks: mark a message by clicking its role icon and jump back to it later

plan.title: Conversation bookmarks: mark a message by clicking its role icon and jump back to it later
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Long conversations bury the messages worth returning to (findings, decisions, drafts). The timeline offers search but no way to mark a message and come back to it after a reload.
narratives.Proposal: Store operator bookmarks in a new conversation_bookmarks table in overdeck.db (door src/lib/overdeck/conversation-bookmarks.ts) keyed by conversation and the transcript's stable message id, exposed through GET/PUT/DELETE /api/conversations/:name/bookmarks. In the dashboard, a ConversationBookmarksProvider (react-query) wraps ConversationPanel; the role icon of each message in the main timeline becomes a button (assistant Bot, new user User icon) that bookmarks with a first-line default label and turns into a filled Bookmark marker; clicking it again opens a rename/remove popover; a header Bookmarks toggle opens a drawer listing label and time with rename/remove, and clicking an entry scrolls the virtualized timeline to the message and flashes it for 1600 ms. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4498.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Bookmarks across conversations (a global list)
- Offering bookmarked messages as handoff context
- Copying bookmarks to a fork or handoff successor conversation
- Bookmarking work-log/tool rows, slash-command dividers, fork-summary or review-context blocks, command results, system rows, optimistic/held/subagent-routed user messages, or streaming messages
- Bookmarking in SubagentTranscript, SessionTranscript, DirectoryTranscript or TerminalPanel timelines
- Live cross-tab or cross-device sync (no event emission)
- A pan CLI verb for bookmarks
- Writing anything into the harness transcript or changing any transcript parser or message id derivation
- Server-side checks that a message id exists in the transcript
- Auto-switching from terminal view or a subagent transcript to the main timeline when a bookmark is clicked
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap

autoDecisions.summary: Store bookmarks in a new conversation_bookmarks table in overdeck.db behind a door module
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires Overdeck-side storage that survives reloads; bookmarks are operator-authored facts that cannot be derived, and conversation_pull_requests (PAN-3822) is the established per-conversation table + door precedent. localStorage would not survive another browser.

autoDecisions.summary: First click on a role icon bookmarks; a second click opens a rename/remove popover
autoDecisions.rationale: Satisfies both issue phrases ('clicking its role icon bookmarks' and 'remove or rename ... by clicking the icon again') without making removal a single accidental click.

autoDecisions.summary: The bookmarked marker is the role icon itself rendered as a filled primary Bookmark glyph
autoDecisions.rationale: Smallest visual change that meets 'a marker appears on it'; primary color is used only for an active state per the style guide.

autoDecisions.summary: Add a User role icon right of user message bubbles in every MessagesTimeline mount; it is a button only in the main conversation timeline
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue refers to a user marker that does not exist today; mirroring the existing Bot icon (rendered everywhere) keeps the timelines consistent.

autoDecisions.summary: Default label = first non-empty line, markdown prefix and emphasis stripped, 80 chars with ellipsis; computed client-side
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's example shows a first-line excerpt; the client already holds the message text, so the server only validates length.

autoDecisions.summary: Bookmarks list is a drawer under the header opened by a Bookmarks toggle next to About/Tools, not shown in embedded panels
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses the existing About drawer pattern and toggle styling; embedded panels hide the header by contract.

autoDecisions.summary: Jump flashes a 2px primary outline for 1600 ms and reports a missing message in the drawer
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses the outline style the palette-target path already uses; 'highlights it briefly' needs a bounded duration.

autoDecisions.summary: GET route scoped read:conversations; PUT/DELETE left unlisted (admin) in ROUTE_SCOPES
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the kickoff GET precedent; the scope table grows minimally and fails closed for writes.

autoDecisions.summary: Limit 500 bookmarks per conversation and 200-char labels
autoDecisions.rationale: Bounds an operator-annotation table without affecting realistic use.

autoDecisions.summary: Style new UI with Tailwind utilities; do not edit command-deck.module.css
autoDecisions.rationale: messageRows.tsx already uses Tailwind utilities; avoiding the shared CSS module removes a shared-file edge between items and keeps the plan under the 25-file surface limit.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not add the new frontend tests to package.json test:frontend-subset
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches PAN-4499's chat tests; each item's verify_commands run them explicitly, and the root package.json line is a frequent merge-conflict point.

items.title: Add the conversation_bookmarks table and its door module

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-1 exactly (.pan/drafts/PAN-4498.md): add the conversation_bookmarks CREATE TABLE to drizzle/overdeck/0000_overdeck_init.sql after the idx_conversation_pull_requests_key line, add the matching runSchemaTopUp CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS after line 124 of src/lib/overdeck/infra.ts, and create the door src/lib/overdeck/conversation-bookmarks.ts exporting ConversationBookmark, the three limit constants, validateBookmarkInput, listConversationBookmarks, upsertConversationBookmark (transaction; not-found/limit/saved) and removeConversationBookmark. Resolve conversations.id by name in SQL; never use LegacyConversation.id. Write the named tests in src/lib/overdeck/__tests__/conversation-bookmarks.test.ts using the temp OVERDECK_HOME pattern of conversation-kickoff-store.test.ts.

items.title: Given a conversation, when upsertConversationBookmark is called twice for the same messageId with different labels, then listConversationBookmarks returns one bookmark with the second label and the original createdAt
Given 500 bookmarks on a conversation, when a new messageId is upserted, then the door returns status 'limit', and renaming an existing bookmark still returns 'saved'
Given an unknown conversation name, when upsertConversationBookmark is called, then it returns status 'not-found' and writes no row

validateBookmarkInput rejects a messageId starting with 'optimistic-', an empty trimmed label, a label over 200 chars, and a messageCreatedAt that Date.parse cannot parse, each with the PRD error string
A database created from the init SQL and a database upgraded through the infra.ts top-up both contain a conversation_bookmarks table with the FR-1 columns
Expose GET/PUT/DELETE bookmark routes under /api/conversations/:name/bookmarks

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-2: new route file src/dashboard/server/routes/conversation-bookmarks.ts modeled on routes/conversation-kickoff.ts (validateOrigin, decodeURIComponent of :name and :messageId, 404 via getConversationByName, door calls), exporting conversationBookmarksRouteLayer; register it in server.ts next to conversationKickoffRouteLayer (import ~line 71, layer ~line 312); add only the GET row to ROUTE_SCOPES as read:conversations (PUT/DELETE stay unlisted = admin, decision D9); add the three no-loss-matrix rows from the PRD after the kickoff rows. Write the named route tests.

items.title: GET /api/conversations/:name/bookmarks returns 200 { bookmarks: [] } for a conversation with none, then returns the saved bookmark after a PUT

PUT /api/conversations/:name/bookmarks/:messageId returns 200 { bookmark } on create and on rename, 400 for an empty label or an optimistic- id, and 409 { error: 'Bookmark limit reached (500)' } at the limit
DELETE /api/conversations/:name/bookmarks/:messageId returns { removed: true } once and { removed: false } after
All three routes return 404 { error: 'Conversation not found' } for an unknown conversation name
ROUTE_SCOPES maps GET /api/conversations/:name/bookmarks to read:conversations and the no-loss matrix contains rows for all three routes
Add the ConversationBookmarksProvider context and mount it in ConversationPanel

Wrap ConversationPanel's root right inside ConversationPullRequestProvider (line ~698) with ConversationBookmarksProvider conversationName={conversation.name}. If a test that mounts ConversationPanel fails with an unexpected GET .../bookmarks request, add a handler returning { bookmarks: [] } to that test's mock (do not weaken installStrictFetchMock).

items.title: defaultBookmarkLabel returns the first non-empty line with a leading markdown prefix, backticks and ** removed, cut to 80 chars plus '…', and returns 'Bookmarked message' for blank text
Given GET .../bookmarks returns two bookmarks, when the provider mounts, then useConversationBookmarks().byMessageId contains both message ids
Given GET .../bookmarks responds 500 or the fetch rejects, when ConversationPanel renders, then it renders with zero bookmarks and shows no toast

Given the provider is mounted, when jumpTo('m1') is called, then jumpRequest returns { messageId: 'm1' } with a nonce one higher than before, and when resolveJump(thatNonce, false) is called, then missingMessageId returns 'm1'
useConversationBookmarks() returns null when rendered outside ConversationBookmarksProvider
Make the message role icon a bookmark button with a bookmarked marker

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-4: new MessageRoleIcon component (reads useConversationBookmarks(); plain aria-hidden icon when not bookmarkable or outside a provider; otherwise a button that adds a bookmark with defaultBookmarkLabel(message.text) and message.createdAt, and renders a filled lucide Bookmark with text-primary and aria-pressed=true when bookmarked). Replace the Bot icon at messageRows.tsx line ~220 with it; add a User role icon right of the normal user bubble (plain icon in the held and subagent branches). Thread a bookmarkable boolean through TimelineRowRenderer RowProps, add bookmarksEnabled?: boolean to MessagesTimelineProps (types.ts), pass bookmarkable={bookmarksEnabled} from both MessagesTimeline row mounts, and set bookmarksEnabled only on ConversationView's MessagesTimeline in ConversationPanel.tsx (never in SubagentTranscript). Apply decision D11 (no optimistic, held, subagent-routed, command-result, system or streaming rows). Tailwind utilities only; do not edit command-deck.module.css. Clicking a bookmarked icon does nothing in this item (popover comes in bookmark-edit-popover).

items.title: Given an assistant message in a bookmarks-enabled timeline, when its role icon is clicked, then a PUT to /api/conversations/<name>/bookmarks/<encoded id> is sent with label equal to defaultBookmarkLabel(message.text)
Given a user message in a bookmarks-enabled timeline, when the User icon right of the bubble is clicked, then the user message is bookmarked the same way
Given a bookmarked message, then its role icon renders a filled Bookmark icon with aria-pressed='true' and title 'Bookmarked: <label>'
Given bookmarksEnabled is false, or no provider, or an optimistic-/held/streaming message, then the role icon renders as a non-button icon and no request is sent
Given a bookmarked message, when the bookmark list refetches and new messages are appended to the timeline, then the marker stays on the same message id
Open a rename/remove popover when a bookmarked role icon is clicked

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-5 inside MessageRoleIcon.tsx: a BookmarkEditPopover anchored under the icon (relative wrapper; absolute left-0 top-full z-30 w-64 rounded-lg border border-border bg-popover p-2 shadow-lg) with an input aria-label 'Bookmark label' (maxLength 200) pre-filled with the label, Save and Remove buttons. Enter or Save renames via ctx.rename when the trimmed value is non-empty and changed; an empty value closes without a request; Escape and an outside mousedown close it; Remove calls ctx.remove. Clicking a bookmarked icon toggles the popover.

items.title: Given a bookmarked message, when its role icon is clicked, then a popover opens with an input labelled 'Bookmark label' containing the current label
Given the popover is open, when the operator types a new label and presses Enter, then a PUT with the new label is sent and the popover closes
Given the popover is open, when Remove is clicked, then a DELETE is sent and the icon renders the role icon with aria-pressed='false'
Given the popover is open, when Escape is pressed or the label is cleared and Enter pressed, then the popover closes and no request is sent
Add the Bookmarks header toggle and the bookmarks drawer list

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-6: new BookmarksDrawer.tsx exporting BookmarksToggle (conversationAboutToggle classes, lucide Bookmark 14px, text 'Bookmarks' plus count when > 0, aria-pressed, aria-label 'Show bookmarks'/'Hide bookmarks') and BookmarksDrawer (only when listOpen; role='list' aria-label='Bookmarks'; per row a label button calling ctx.jumpTo, the time formatTimestamp(messageCreatedAt ?? createdAt), a pencil 'Rename bookmark' inline editor (Enter saves via rename, Escape cancels), a '×' 'Remove bookmark' button; empty-state text from FR-11). Both return null outside a provider. In ConversationPanel.tsx add one import, <BookmarksToggle /> after the Tools toggle, and {!embedded && <BookmarksDrawer />} after the About drawer block. Checkpoint: ConversationPanel.tsx must stay within its allowlist cap (bash scripts/lint-file-size.sh passes); if not, extract the About/Tools toggles into components/chat/ConversationHeaderToggles.tsx. Never raise the allowlist.

items.title: Given a conversation with 2 bookmarks, then the header toggle renders 'Bookmarks 2', and clicking it renders a list labelled 'Bookmarks' with each bookmark's label and formatted time
Given the drawer is open, when 'Rename bookmark' is clicked and a new label entered with Enter, then a PUT with the new label is sent and the row shows it
Given the drawer is open, when 'Remove bookmark' is clicked, then a DELETE is sent and the row disappears
Given no bookmarks, when the drawer opens, then it renders 'No bookmarks yet. Click the icon beside a message to bookmark it.'
bash scripts/lint-file-size.sh passes with ConversationPanel.tsx at or under its allowlist cap
Scroll to and flash a bookmarked message when its drawer entry is clicked

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-7: in MessagesTimeline.tsx read useConversationBookmarks() only when bookmarksEnabled; handle each jumpRequest nonce once (handledJumpNonceRef), look the row up by message id, call scrollToRow(index, row.id) and set flashRowId, report resolveJump(nonce, found); clear flashRowId after 1600 ms via setTimeout with cleanup; add `|| flashRowId === row.id` to the outline condition of both row wrappers. In BookmarksDrawer.tsx show 'This message is not in the loaded transcript.' under the row whose messageId equals missingMessageId. Tests use vi.useFakeTimers()/vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync, never real waits.

items.title: Given a bookmark on a message inside the virtualized region of a long timeline, when jumpTo is called, then the virtualizer scrolls to that row and its wrapper renders a 2px solid var(--color-primary) outline
Given a flashed row, when 1600 ms of fake time advance, then the outline is removed
Given a jump request for a message id not in the rows, then resolveJump(nonce, false) is called and the drawer renders 'This message is not in the loaded transcript.' under that bookmark
Given the same nonce is delivered twice, or bookmarksEnabled is false, then no scroll occurs for the repeat or disabled case
